notes.hook: nothing for 6 seconds, then 'Assalam walekum ji, ye hamare Afzal bhai hain'
notes.what_goes_wrong: Six seconds with no words, then a greeting, then 'complete video dekhiyega': the reel is a trailer for another video.
notes.reusable_pattern: Avoid: greeting-first vlogs that send people to 'the complete video'; the reel has to pay off on its own.
